name: Sacred Garden (Lumbini)
description: Sacred Garden (Lumbini) is a notable religious destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. UNESCO World Heritage birthplace of Lord Buddha, showcasing the Maya Devi Temple, Ashokan Pillar, revered Pond, and a vast international monastic zone drawing pilgrims from across the globe. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

name: Maya Devi Temple
description: Maya Devi Temple is a notable religious destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Most revered monument in Lumbini, built directly over the age-old marker stone indicating the exact birthplace of Lord Buddha, surrounded by archaeological excavations revealing Mauryan and pre-Mauryan remains. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

name: Ashoka Pillar
description: Ashoka Pillar is a notable religious destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Erected by Emperor Ashoka during his pilgrimage to Lumbini in 249 BC, this carved sandstone pillar bears an inscription confirming the exact birthplace of the Buddha, making it one of the oldest dated records in South Asian history. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

name: World Peace Pagoda (Lumbini)
description: World Peace Pagoda (Lumbini) is a notable heritage destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Brilliant white Japanese-style stupa rising above the Lumbini plain, built by the Nipponzan Myohoji Buddhist Order as a symbol of world peace, providing a serene focal point visible across the entire revered zone. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

name: Monastic Zone (Lumbini)
description: Monastic Zone (Lumbini) is a notable heritage destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Meticulously planned zone showcasing over twenty monasteries built by Buddhist nations including China, Japan, Korea, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam, and Sri Lanka, each reflecting their unique architectural and spiritual traditions. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

name: Gautam Buddha International Airport
description: Gautam Buddha International Airport is a notable urban destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Nepal's second international airport named after the Buddha, serving as the primary international entry point to Lumbini and facilitating direct pilgrimage flights from Buddhist nations across Asia and the world. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

description: Bhairahawa (Siddharthanagar) is a notable urban destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Major international border city and administrative capital of Rupandehi, functioning as the primary commercial and transit hub connecting the Lumbini pilgrimage circuit to India and showcasing vibrant bazaars and industrial corridors. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

name: Butwal
description: Butwal is a notable urban destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. One of the fastest-growing and most economically dynamic cities in western Nepal, positioned at the strategic confluence of the hills and plains where the Tinau River meets the Terai flatlands. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

name: Rani Mahal (Palpa - accessible from Rupandehi)
description: Rani Mahal (Palpa - accessible from Rupandehi) is a notable heritage destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Often called the Taj Mahal of Nepal, this striking neoclassical riverside palace was built in the 19th century by Khadga Shumsher Rana in memory of his beloved queen, set dramatically on the edge of a vertical cliff above the Kaligandaki River. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

name: Jitgadh Fort
description: Jitgadh Fort is a notable heritage destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Historic fortification where Nepalese soldiers famously defeated advancing British forces during the 1814 Anglo-Nepal War, now partially reclaimed by jungle and serving as an emerging heritage tourism site with patriotic significance. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

name: Gajedi Taal
description: Gajedi Taal is a notable lake destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Scenic natural lake surrounded by lush vegetation, popular among locals for boating, picnicking, and birdwatching, providing a peaceful natural escape just outside the urban bustle of Butwal. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

description: Hill Park (Butwal) is a notable hill station destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers a moderate experience well suited to families and casual travelers.
